This value set contains 8 concepts

tr.td: Public Health
Activities in the area of public health, including protection against serious cross-border threats to health and public-health surveillance.
Policy-Making and Regulatory Activities
Public-sector policy-making, planning, supervision, or regulatory activities in the health or care sectors.

tr.td: Official Statistics
Preparation and production of official statistics relating to health or care.
Education or Teaching
Education or teaching activities in the health or care sectors.
Scientific Research
Scientific research related to health or care that contributes to public health or health-technology development.
Development and Innovation
Development and innovation activities for products, services, or processes contributing to public health, healthcare, or care.
Training, Testing and Evaluation of Algorithms
Training, testing, and evaluation of algorithms, including algorithms used in medical devices, in-vitro diagnostic medical devices, AI systems, or digital health applications.

tr.td: Primary Use
Use of personal electronic health data for the provision of healthcare to the individual concerned.
Secondary Use
Use of electronic health data for a permitted purpose other than the direct provision of healthcare to the individual concerned.

div.p: Expansion performed internally based on codesystem EU AI Case-Specific Indication Code System v0.1.0 (CodeSystem)
This value set contains 6 concepts

tr.td: Triage and Prioritization
Use of the AI system to support urgency assessment, prioritization, or routing.
Screening
Use of the AI system to identify individuals or findings that may require further assessment.
Second Opinion
Use of the AI system to provide an additional assessment alongside a human clinical assessment.
Diagnostic Support
Use of the AI system to support the identification or assessment of a diagnosis.
Treatment Planning
Use of the AI system to support selection, planning, or adaptation of treatment.
Prognostic Prediction
Use of the AI system to estimate a future clinical outcome, risk, or disease course.

div.p: Expansion performed internally based on codesystem EU AI Clinical Validation Status Code System v0.1.0 (CodeSystem)
This value set contains 4 concepts

tr.td: Clinically Validated
Clinical validation for the documented intended use has been completed.
Not Clinically Validated
Clinical validation for the documented intended use has not been completed.
Validation In Progress
Clinical validation is ongoing and no final validation conclusion has yet been documented.
Technical Validation Only
Technical verification or validation has been performed, but clinical validation for the intended use has not been completed.

title.value: EU AI Clinical Validation Status Value Set

div.p: Expansion performed internally based on codesystem EU AI Data Quality Code System v0.1.0 (CodeSystem)
This value set contains 4 concepts

tr.td: Representative
The data are assessed as sufficiently representative of the relevant population, setting, or intended use.
Error-Controlled
The data were subject to measures intended to identify, reduce, and manage errors.
Complete
The data are assessed as sufficiently complete for the documented purpose.
Relevant
The data are assessed as relevant to the documented purpose and intended use.

title.value: EU AI Data Quality Value Set

p.style: border: black 1px dotted; background-color: #EEEEEE; padding: 8px; margin-bottom: 8px

div.p: Expansion performed internally based on codesystem EU AI Human Oversight Code System v0.1.0 (CodeSystem)
This value set contains 3 concepts

tr.td: Human Validation
A human reviewer assessed the AI output and accepted it without changing its substantive content.
Human Override
A human reviewer rejected the AI output or recommendation.
Human Correction
A human reviewer corrected erroneous or incomplete AI-generated content while retaining the corrected result as the documented outcome.

title.value: EU AI Human Oversight Action Value Set

p.style: border: black 1px dotted; background-color: #EEEEEE; padding: 8px; margin-bottom: 8px

div.p: Expansion performed internally based on codesystem EU AI Involvement Code System v0.1.0 (CodeSystem)
This value set contains 4 concepts

tr.td: AI Generated
The substantive content of the resource was generated by an AI system.
AI Assisted
An AI system supported a human author, while the human remained responsible for creating the substantive content.
AI Reported
An AI system transformed or reported existing information without independently asserting its clinical validity.
AI Asserted
An AI system asserted clinical or factual content as an output of its processing.

p.style: border: black 1px dotted; background-color: #EEEEEE; padding: 8px; margin-bottom: 8px

div.p: Expansion performed internally based on codesystem EU AI Performance Metric Code System v0.1.0 (CodeSystem)
This value set contains 4 concepts

tr.td: Accuracy
The proportion of evaluated cases for which the AI system produced the correct result.
Sensitivity
The proportion of relevant positive cases correctly identified by the AI system.
Specificity
The proportion of relevant negative cases correctly identified by the AI system.
Robustness
The ability of the AI system to maintain appropriate performance under variations, disturbances, or reasonably foreseeable conditions of use.

title.value: EU AI Performance Metric Value Set

div.p: Expansion performed internally based on codesystem GDPR Article 6 Legal Basis Code System v0.1.0 (CodeSystem)
This value set contains 6 concepts

tr.td: Consent (Art. 6(1)(a))
The data subject has given consent to the processing of personal data for one or more specific purposes.
Contract (Art. 6(1)(b))
Processing is necessary for the performance of a contract with the data subject or for pre-contractual measures requested by the data subject.
Legal Obligation (Art. 6(1)(c))
Processing is necessary for compliance with a legal obligation to which the controller is subject.
Vital Interests (Art. 6(1)(d))
Processing is necessary to protect the vital interests of the data subject or another natural person.
Public Interest or Official Authority (Art. 6(1)(e))
Processing is necessary for a task carried out in the public interest or in the exercise of official authority vested in the controller.

button.data-clipboard-text: <coding><system value="http://example.org/fhir/eu-ai-transparency/CodeSystem/gdpr-art6-codesystem"><version value="0.1.0"><code value="gdpr-art-6-1-e"><display value="Public Interest or Official Authority (Art. 6(1)(e))"></coding>
button.title: Click to Copy as Coding

tr.td: Legitimate Interests (Art. 6(1)(f))
Processing is necessary for legitimate interests pursued by the controller or a third party, subject to the conditions and limitations of Article 6(1)(f) GDPR.

title.value: GDPR Article 6 Legal Basis Value Set

div.p: Expansion performed internally based on codesystem GDPR Article 9 Condition Code System v0.1.0 (CodeSystem)
This value set contains 6 concepts

tr.td: Explicit Consent (Art. 9(2)(a))
The data subject has given explicit consent to the processing for one or more specified purposes, subject to applicable legal limitations.
Vital Interests (Art. 9(2)(c))
Processing is necessary to protect vital interests where the data subject is physically or legally incapable of giving consent.
Substantial Public Interest (Art. 9(2)(g))
Processing is necessary for reasons of substantial public interest on the basis of Union or Member State law and subject to appropriate safeguards.
Health or Social Care (Art. 9(2)(h))

Processing is necessary for preventive or occupational medicine, medical diagnosis, provision or management of health or social care, or related systems and services, subject to the applicable legal conditions.

button.data-clipboard-text: <coding><system value="http://example.org/fhir/eu-ai-transparency/CodeSystem/gdpr-art9-codesystem"><version value="0.1.0"><code value="gdpr-art-9-2-h"><display value="Health or Social Care (Art. 9(2)(h))"></coding>
button.title: Click to Copy as Coding

tr.td: Public Health (Art. 9(2)(i))
Processing is necessary for reasons of public interest in the area of public health on the basis of Union or Member State law and subject to appropriate safeguards.
Research and Statistics (Art. 9(2)(j))
Processing is necessary for archiving in the public interest, scientific or historical research, or statistical purposes, subject to Article 89(1) GDPR and an applicable legal basis.
